environment.npm: v12.2.0 (global npm prefix prepended for this run)
environment.database_role: symphony_app API and repository tests; test-admin/migration role for synthetic fixture setup and schema install

commands.command: npm run test:api (Fastify and PostgreSQL integration; 25 tests)
npm run test:db:migrations (PostgreSQL migration/session integration; 17 tests)

claims.behavior_proved: Opaque PostgreSQL-backed sessions enforce the approved idle and absolute lifetimes, login rotation, current-session logout, all-session revocation on forced password change, synchronizer CSRF tokens, exact Origin validation, and forced-change route restrictions. Shared account/source throttles use HMAC identifiers and transactionally coordinate across API instances.
claims.path_proved: The Fastify integration uses app-role PostgreSQL connections for temporary login, forced-change denial, permanent password establishment, session revocation, fresh login and cross-instance shared throttle history. Migration integration covers expiration boundaries, rotation, logout/revocation and bounded throttling. Current candidate reruns retain all raw logs listed above.
claims.configuration_proved: Local synthetic test mode on PostgreSQL 18.0. Authentication identity and tenant are session-derived; the runtime API uses symphony_app. No production database or key provider is asserted.
coverage_limitations: No production deployment configuration, production expected-load qualification or independent security review is claimed.
The privilege/tenant-change session rotation hook is implemented and repository-tested; no authorized business route currently consumes it because the command facade is downstream of WP5.3.
